prompts.horizon: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one wide side-scrolling background plate for the Atmosfera Sombria level of a polished 2D gothic zombie game. A sinister high atmosphere above a midnight-violet world blends upward into nearly black wine-burgundy outer space. Horizontal panoramic 16:9 or 2:1 canvas. Star-speckled blue-black at the lower edge, dark aubergine and wispy dusty carmine plasma higher up, deep ink-black corners, faint very distant scattered embers and layered broken striations of thin crimson nebula. Dense painterly dark gothic brushwork on the cloud edges, restrained cinematic light, subtly textured. Palette dominated by midnight indigo and deep red plum with small copper-red accents. Visually asymmetric, lively striations across the left and right edges and a spacious, low-contrast center for high-contrast gameplay sprites. Distance and scale, quiet terror. No foreground creatures, large planets, characters, hard horizon line, text, letters, HUD, borders, white space, earth, or floor. The atmosphere should feel like the same blue night sky thinning out gradually into haunted orbit. Wide opaque background art, fills the entire image.
